encoding: RFC 8785 JCS, UTF-8, over the FR-331 ZoneCertificate value; states are illustrative state keys, not computed from a model

vectors.description: Refinement-form certificate of the TReq safety half (FR-430-AC-1 shape): two positions, two nodes, two edges, one initial state.
Time-lock-freedom shape: component index per node, reasons per component, divergence target per node, no refinement.

Refinement form with two initial states, the first failing check_initial and time-locked: initials[0] is a locked entry node carrying the reserved index positions.len(), admitted starts at the positioned initials[1], and there are no edges, so taken is empty.

Two-state fixed-work periodic cycle: activation creates the rank-zero live job in the target; completion names that job in the source. Repeated cycles reuse the finite rank and slot while exact replay occurrence increases.
A completes while task B stays live; task A is then activated again. The finite rank and slot are reused for A while B keeps its original live identity and order.
Closed timed source product with no reachable task release; variable demand is irrelevant and no scheduler clocks or task edges are present.
Schema-valid no-release closure certificate bound to the checked CtlFp claim and its task row; ZC-28 uses it to isolate reachable-release refusal.

malformed_vectors.description: An exact task-transition identity with global occurrence and generation cannot stand in for a finite certificate template.
A finite template cannot carry a global job occurrence.
A bounded-subtraction row cannot carry an exact task-transition identity.
The no-release closure marker requires a zero live-job cap.
A no-release closure still carries at least one checked task demand row.

task_reader_vectors.description: A task template rank beyond the recomputed number of live jobs is refused by the reader.
A task template slot bound to a different live job is refused by the reader.
A no-release closure matching TC-372 CtlFp is refused because its checked Cell::set release binding is reachable and no corresponding task-product successor is certified.
